objectives.title: Read Michelle's flag
objectives.prompt: Log in to the Express site as Michelle and read the flag on the flag page.
hints: The login form is parsed by the urlencoded body parser in extended mode: a field does not have to be a string.
Read how the Node.js mysql library turns an object passed as a query value into SQL.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Node.js web framework serves the login page? (name only)

steps.title: Find the database library
steps.prompt: Which Node.js library builds the login query? (package name)

steps.title: Name the vulnerability class
steps.prompt: What vulnerability class lets an object-typed field change the meaning of the login query?

steps.title: Pick the target
steps.prompt: Which user's account holds the flag? (username)
